candidate_a_cc.verdict: Partially pipelined; fails 600 MHz target budget
candidate_a_cc.evidence: In Stage 2A, the 20-bit variable barrel shifter ({12'd0, raw1} << p1) and the 32-bit saturation subtractor (aligned - (sat1 ? mag1 : 0)) remain coupled in a single combinational stage before magnitude2a. In Stage 2B, only negate was split. Cascaded shifter + 32-bit carry chain + net delay (~1.55ns) exceeds effective data budget of ~1.40ns at 600 MHz.

candidate_b_csa.verdict: Dual-rail inside accumulation, but CPA output is unclocked and cascades into upper collection path
candidate_b_csa.evidence: CPA at line 141 'assign sum = $signed(sum_s + sum_c);' is an unclocked continuous assignment. All 256 CPAs (12,288 full adders) toggle continuously every compute cycle. When reading out, block_engine_l1bank_v020 feeds combinational CPA directly through 256:4 mux into a second 49-bit adder (c_old + sums) before BRAM. The critical path was not eliminated, but shifted outside the PE to the memory collection boundary.

cdc_and_constraints_audit.required_remedy: For 300/600 MHz domains, set_max_delay -datapath_only must be re-constrained to < 1.667 ns, set_bus_skew to < 0.800 ns, and CDC-15 depth-0 paths must use ASYNC_REG synchronizers.
